title: hivemind-assimilate-skill workflow + end-to-end proof
description: Wave-1 primitive and the slice-proving E2E. A workflow that assimilates a third-party skill into the framework: fetch source -> detectLicense (TASK-117) -> on permissive auto-proceed / on copyleft|unknown PAUSE for an explicit human decision -> re-scope the frontmatter + append a '## Sources & provenance (hivemind)' block (origin, pinned commit/version, spdx_id, sha256 integrity, assimilated_at) -> write under .claude/skills/<scoped>/ -> record in the lockfile with an owners edge (via applier/store). Mirrors the existing vendored Spine-skill pattern (skills/impl-*). Test corpus = the 'Diseno Poderoso' skills group (doc §8): a known-permissive skill for the auto-OK path, and GSAP / UI-UX-Pro-Max (non-plain-MIT) for the human-gate path. MCP resources (shadcn-vue, Firecrawl, Playwright, context7) are out of scope (Wave 2).
acceptance_criteria: Assimilating a known-permissive-licensed skill completes without a human prompt, writes the scoped skill under .claude/skills/ with a '## Sources & provenance (hivemind)' block containing origin, pinned commit/version, spdx_id, sha256 integrity, and assimilated_at, and records a lock entry with the pack as an owner.
Assimilating a copyleft/unknown-licensed skill PAUSES and requires an explicit human decision before writing anything; on decline, nothing is written.
E2E: assimilate one real permissive skill from the design-doc group, reconcile it in, then remove it and verify the skill directory is gone and the lock entry is orphaned/removed (orphan cleanup).
A UAT script covers (1) permissive auto-path, (2) copyleft human-gate path, (3) removal/orphan-cleanup, each with a PASS/FAIL step.

comments.author: uat
comments.body:
UAT — hivemind-assimilate-skill workflow (human-gate policy). Human signed off (PASS) on 2026-07-08; steps 3-4 delegated to the Orchestrator at the human's request.

Step 1 (AC1) — Skill returns a review card (license + provenance) and writes nothing without approval. Expected: pending_approval + no files/lock. Observed: live run of GSAP gsap-core (github.com/greensock/gsap-skills, subdir skills/gsap-core) returned spdx_id=MIT, detected_via=license-file, status=pending_approval, integrity=sha256:b891...542; no assimilated-skills/ dir, no integrations.lock.json written. Verdict: PASS.

Step 2 (AC2) — Copyleft/unknown gated, nothing written. Observed: pre-fix GSAP run (classification unknown) returned awaiting_human/pending, wrote nothing; copyleft fixture E2E green; invariant sweep {permissive,copyleft}x{absent,decline} all no-write. Verdict: PASS.

Step 3 (AC3) — Approve -> materialize into .claude/skills/ then remove -> orphan cleanup. Observed: fixture E2E (assimilate w/ approve -> plan -> applyPlan -> remove -> cleanup) green. Verified by Orchestrator at the human's request. Verdict: PASS.

Step 4 (AC4) — probeSkills + plan() ids line up after materialize. Observed: fixture E2E green (post-materialize plan yields no spurious install/remove). Verified by Orchestrator at the human's request. Verdict: PASS.

Step 5 (AC5) — Integrity is a real sha256 + 64-hex over source. Observed: live GSAP integrity sha256:b891c9ed...529a542 (64 hex) over the source content. Verdict: PASS.

AC1 amendment: original wording ("assimilates without prompt") superseded by the human-gate policy locked 2026-07-08 — no skill auto-adopts; permissive returns pending_approval. All 5 ACs PASS under the new gate.

Overall: PASS. The UAT bounce (real GSAP run) surfaced 3 license-detection gaps + the license-is-not-safety insight; fixes landed and the human-gate policy (no auto-adopt, content review + sign-off always) was adopted. Actual adoption of real skills deferred to TASK-122 (content security scan + reviewer).

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Closed on UAT PASS (human sign-off 2026-07-08) after a full-depth code review (rev-120 APPROVE) plus a UAT-bounce RC cycle. Review depth = FULL. The live UAT on a real skill (GSAP) bounced the ticket once: safety held perfectly (fail-closed, nothing written) but detection missed a legitimately-MIT skill, surfacing 3 gaps fixed in ecaf6b4 (Gap B repoRoot LICENSE-text forwarding + Gap C unauthenticated GitHub fetcher) and a reverted forgeable-frontmatter attempt (dda86e4/f1e22c8 -> ca12112/1b0b9f1). A human policy decision then removed the permissive auto-adopt path entirely (1b66c77): NO skill adopts without an explicit approve, for any classification; license is decision-support only. Delta re-review APPROVE, no HIGH/MEDIUM; the no-write-without-approve invariant is proven by a non-vacuous {permissive,copyleft}x{absent,decline} sweep. Gate GREEN: npm test 751 passed/2 skipped; assimilate e2e 9 passed. Carried follow-ups: TASK-121 (planner staged-vs-live divergence), TASK-122 (content security scan + reviewer + mandatory sign-off), and a trivial stale test-header comment (license-file is step 2). Knowledge draft written for the license-is-not-safety lesson.
